[SWS_StbM_00515]
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_00008
⌈If the range of the corresponding HW reference counter is less than that of the Vir-
tual Local Time (refer to StbM_VirtualLocalTimeType), the StbM shall extend the
range accordingly.⌋
Note: Depending on the HW reference clock one way of extending the range is to
count overflows of the HW reference clock.
